Name: Cononiah, the Levite
Summary: Cononiah the Levite was ruler over the offerings, tithes and dedicated things brought faithfully into the house of the LORD under Hezekiah, with Shimei his brother next.
KeyStory: Cononiah the Levite was ruler over the offerings and tithes, and Shimei his brother was the next.
RelatedPeople: Shimei, Brother of Cononiah; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Faithful handling of gifts honours both giver and God.
